versions.changelog:
Initial release of vita-app skill.

- Connects to VITA to provide users with personal health data and daily AI insights.
- Supports fetching today’s AI summary, wearable metrics (Oura/WHOOP), and active supplement protocols.
- Includes setup instructions for API key and environment configuration.
- Describes three main actions: get_daily_insight, get_todays_outlook, and get_protocols.
- Outlines recommended usage patterns for querying and presenting health data.
